bugs.name: Greeting 'hi' fallthrough to expensive reasoning / silence
bugs.symptom: Casual greetings ('hi', 'hello', 'hey friday') routed to heavy LLM reasoning with high latency or potential silence.
bugs.reproduction: Submit query 'hi' or 'hello' to system router without local model active.
bugs.observed_evidence: Latency exceeded 3500ms; if local model offline, returned connection error instead of conversational greeting.
bugs.failure_boundary: Semantic intent classification layer in semantic_router.py and engine.py.
bugs.root_cause: Missing deterministic conversational fast path for common greetings in Tier 0 router.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Router evaluated embeddings or LLM decider for trivial single-word greetings.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented Tier 0 regex fast path (< 1ms) in FridayBrain.execute_smart_skill and semantic router prioritizing greetings.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified instant response ('Good morning/afternoon/evening, Boss...') under 2ms.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents denial-of-service on local reasoning server from greeting loops.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Only standard English greetings covered in regex; regional colloquialisms route through semantic router.

bugs.name: Compound command parsing failure
bugs.symptom: Multi-clause directives ('open notepad and type FRIDAY IS TESTING CONTEXT') treated as monolithic application names.
bugs.reproduction: Issue 'open notepad and type hello' -> attempted to find executable named 'notepad and type hello'.
bugs.observed_evidence: Win32 launch error: 'Could not find application notepad and type hello'.
bugs.failure_boundary: Compound natural language intent parsing in agent/planner.py and agent/compound.py.
bugs.root_cause: Greedy regex in app launcher matched entire prompt string as target application.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Single-step command architecture lacked dependency DAG planning.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented CompoundIntentParser decomposing commands into sequential PEOV DAG missions with step dependencies.
bugs.runtime_test: Notepad launched, window focused, text injected and verified via UI Automation readback.
bugs.security_implications: All spawned sub-actions pass individually through Gatekeeper authorization.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Compound actions limited to supported skill combinations (launch, type, search, navigate, calculate).

bugs.name: Microphone/audio path real voice integration deficit
bugs.symptom: Voice loop crashed or hung when PyAudio/sounddevice buffer underran or hardware was unattached.
bugs.reproduction: Start voice loop in environment without audio input device.
bugs.observed_evidence: Uncaught sounddevice / pygame.mixer exception terminating main loop.
bugs.failure_boundary: Audio hardware abstraction in friday_ui/core/engine.py and friday.py.
bugs.root_cause: Synchronous mixer initialization and blocking stream reads without device enumeration guards.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Assumed active default microphone and speaker always present and unlocked.
bugs.architectural_fix: Wrapped audio streams in non-blocking try-catch blocks with device enumeration fallback and silent chime stubs.
bugs.runtime_test: Device enumeration, stream opening, and fallback verified in software.
bugs.security_implications: Microphone stream isolated from system command shell.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Physical microphone -> STT -> TTS -> speaker closed-loop acoustic test unverified in headless CI (Rule 0.21).

bugs.name: Critical Windows process termination vulnerability
bugs.symptom: Commands like 'kill csrss.exe' or 'close svchost' could crash the operating system with BSOD.
bugs.reproduction: Issue 'kill process csrss.exe' or target protected processes through gatekeeper.
bugs.observed_evidence: Targeted termination attempted against Windows core processes without security filter.
bugs.failure_boundary: System process lifecycle management in gatekeeper/gatekeeper.py and security/gate.py.
bugs.root_cause: Missing system process deny-list filter before executing taskkill / psutil terminate.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Gatekeeper trusted user intent without cross-referencing protected Windows kernel binaries.
bugs.architectural_fix: Enforced PROTECTED_SYSTEM_PROCESSES fence blocking termination of csrss, lsass, smss, winlogon, services, etc.
bugs.runtime_test: Adversarial termination attempts against 7 critical processes verified blocked with security violation.
bugs.security_implications: Protects Windows OS stability from malicious or accidental command injection.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Does not prevent termination of user-space processes if confirmed by user.

bugs.name: Approval-token replay weakness
bugs.symptom: Tier 2 destructive action approval tokens could be re-used multiple times to authorize different actions.
bugs.reproduction: Capture valid approval token for recycle_file and replay it against another target file.
bugs.observed_evidence: Second action succeeded using stale clearance token.
bugs.failure_boundary: Security gate authorization evaluator in security/gate.py.
bugs.root_cause: Approval tokens were stateless or not invalidated upon single-use consumption.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Token verification only checked token presence and expiration, not consumption status.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented single-use nonce tracking in SecurityGate with immediate token invalidation and replay detection.
bugs.runtime_test: Replay attack test verified immediate rejection with 'replay attack blocked'.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents unauthorized action escalation via token capture.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Tokens expire after 5 minutes; unconsumed tokens remain in memory cache until expiration.

bugs.name: Path traversal and symlink escape
bugs.symptom: Malicious file path parameters (e.g. '..\..\Windows\System32') could escape sandboxed roots.
bugs.reproduction: Issue file modification targeting 'C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts'.
bugs.observed_evidence: Relative path resolution bypassed initial prefix string checks.
bugs.failure_boundary: Path canonicalization and fencing in gatekeeper/gatekeeper.py and security/gate.py.
bugs.root_cause: Path validation evaluated raw strings instead of canonical resolved absolute paths.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Checked `path.startswith()` before `Path(path).resolve()`.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented strict canonicalization via Path.resolve(), junction handling, and system root fence checks.
bugs.runtime_test: 5 adversarial traversal payloads verified blocked by both SecurityGate and Gatekeeper.
bugs.security_implications: Guarantees system files cannot be modified or deleted via path escape.
bugs.remaining_limitations: User desktop and user documents roots remain writable per intentional design.

bugs.name: Thread-safety and state machine race conditions
bugs.symptom: Rapid concurrent state transitions caused corrupt state history or illegal transition errors.
bugs.reproduction: Simultaneously trigger state transitions from multiple threads.
bugs.observed_evidence: Race condition caused AgentStateMachine to report inconsistent current_state.
bugs.failure_boundary: Agent runtime state management in agent/state_machine.py.
bugs.root_cause: State transitions modified internal state and listener lists without mutual exclusion.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: State machine was not thread-safe under multithreaded GUI and voice loops.
bugs.architectural_fix: Added threading.RLock() guarding state transitions, listener notifications, and transition history logging.
bugs.runtime_test: Multithreaded race stress tests verified atomic state transitions without deadlocks.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents unauthorized operations while system is in PAUSED or CANCELLED state.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Listener callbacks must be non-blocking to prevent locking state transitions.

bugs.name: Notepad close false success while process remained alive
bugs.symptom: Assistant reported 'Notepad closed' even if Notepad was still running or prompted 'Do you want to save?'.
bugs.reproduction: Type text in Notepad without saving, then issue 'close notepad'.
bugs.observed_evidence: Alt+F4 caused a modal confirmation prompt, window remained open, but skill returned success.
bugs.failure_boundary: Application close execution and observation in gatekeeper/gatekeeper.py and builtins/apps.py.
bugs.root_cause: Blindly sent Alt+F4 or terminate() without post-condition HWND polling and verification.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: No post-action observation loop verifying process death and window destruction.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented 2.0s polling loop checking psutil process status and uiautomation HWND presence with taskkill fallback.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified close_app polls until window/process confirmed dead, returning verified status.
bugs.security_implications: Ensures background orphaned processes are not left running silently.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Apps with unsaved changes may force taskkill termination if timeout exceeded.

bugs.name: Standalone typing routed to LLM instead of UI action
bugs.symptom: Commands like 'type Hello World into notepad' routed to LLM explaining how to type instead of typing.
bugs.reproduction: Issue 'type FRIDAY ACTIVE into notepad' in chat interface.
bugs.observed_evidence: LLM responded with conversational text: 'I have typed that into notepad' without touching keyboard.
bugs.failure_boundary: Intent dispatching in friday_ui/core/engine.py and router/semantic_router.py.
bugs.root_cause: Missing direct Tier 1 fast path for typing verbs in execute_smart_skill.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Typing commands evaluated by LLM router which misinterpreted intent as conversation.
bugs.architectural_fix: Added Tier 1 fast-path regex interceptor for type/input/enter/paste/append in execute_smart_skill.
bugs.runtime_test: Direct execution of UITypeTextSkill with screen readback verification verified.
bugs.security_implications: Limits keystroke injection to recognized application targets.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Target window must be accessible on current interactive desktop station.

bugs.name: Malformed volume command causing opposite action
bugs.symptom: 'myute the system volume' (typo of mute) could be misinterpreted as unmute or volume up.
bugs.reproduction: Submit prompt 'myute the volume'.
bugs.observed_evidence: Fuzzy string matching matched 'unmute' due to partial character overlaps.
bugs.failure_boundary: Regex and string matching in engine.py and telemetry.py.
bugs.root_cause: Loose regex pattern matching without strict negative lookaheads for opposite intents.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Did not check for typo variants of mute vs unmute explicitly.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented strict phonetic typo mapping (`myute|muet|mut|mue`) explicitly excluding 'unmute'.
bugs.runtime_test: Both 'mute', 'myute', and 'unmute' tested and verified triggering correct volume state.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents accidental blaring audio from acoustic typos.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Highly garbled speech without recognizable volume keywords falls through safely to LLM.

bugs.name: Screenshot false success on missing file
bugs.symptom: System claimed screenshot was taken even if capture failed or output file had 0 bytes.
bugs.reproduction: Trigger screenshot with invalid destination directory or uninitialized display.
bugs.observed_evidence: Success message returned despite file not existing on disk.
bugs.failure_boundary: Desktop action skill in skills/builtins/desktop_action.py.
bugs.root_cause: Returned success based on function call completion rather than on-disk file verification.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Violated PEOV Rule 0.9 (file save call is not proof of write).
bugs.architectural_fix: Added PIL Image verification: checks file exists, stat().st_size > 0, and reopens image verifying width/height > 0.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified screenshot capture validates on-disk byte size and readable image dimensions.
bugs.security_implications: Screenshot files quarantined to user Desktop or APP_DATA_DIR.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Physical visual pixel correctness cannot be audited without computer vision model in loop.

bugs.name: PDF title and content hallucination
bugs.symptom: When asked for PDF title, LLM fabricated plausible titles based on filename or question prompt.
bugs.reproduction: Ask 'what is the title of this pdf' on an untitled or corrupt PDF.
bugs.observed_evidence: LLM generated invented title (e.g. 'Advanced AI Systems Guidelines') not found in metadata.
bugs.failure_boundary: Document QA handler in friday_ui/core/engine.py.
bugs.root_cause: System routed document QA directly to LLM without strict grounding extraction.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Model prior knowledge substituted for missing document metadata.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented zero-hallucination PDF extraction: reads exact pypdf metadata/page 1; returns truthful 'I couldn't verify the title' on failure.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified exact metadata extraction and truthful failure on fabricated titles.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents prompt injection embedded inside untrusted PDF metadata from overriding instructions.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Scanned raster PDFs without OCR layer return unreadable text warning.

bugs.name: PDF context overflow on large documents
bugs.symptom: Asking questions about 100+ page PDFs dumped entire document text into prompt, causing OOM or truncation.
bugs.reproduction: Query large PDF (> 50 pages) in chat.
bugs.observed_evidence: Token count exceeded context window (> 16k tokens), crashing Ollama server.
bugs.failure_boundary: PDF context extraction in engine.py and rag/store.py.
bugs.root_cause: Naive loop appended extracted text from all pages without budgeting.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: No context window token or character cap in document reader.
bugs.architectural_fix: Enforced strict context budgeting: capped document excerpts to <= 2500 tokens (7500 chars) with structural chunking.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified 150-page document query strictly bounded to < 7500 chars.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents denial-of-service via memory exhaustion from massive files.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Very deep queries across hundreds of pages require vector RAG ingestion for full semantic search.

bugs.name: PDF/document questions routing to unrelated telemetry/system skills
bugs.symptom: Questions like 'read this pdf and tell me cpu requirements' triggered local CPU telemetry skill.
bugs.reproduction: Issue 'what does this pdf say about system memory'.
bugs.observed_evidence: Returned current host RAM telemetry instead of reading document content.
bugs.failure_boundary: Semantic router precedence and collision filters in router/semantic_router.py.
bugs.root_cause: Telemetry keyword 'memory' / 'cpu' triggered Tier 0 telemetry before checking document attachment context.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Telemetry pattern matching lacked negative lookbehinds for document context.
bugs.architectural_fix: Added document attachment awareness and contextual question filters prioritizing document pipeline over telemetry.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified prompt 'read this pdf and tell me cpu requirements' routes to document QA.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents leakage of host machine telemetry when user intended external document analysis.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Ambiguous prompts without clear keywords rely on semantic router score threshold.

bugs.name: Generative content writing in Notepad required semantic DAG generation
bugs.symptom: 'open notepad and write a welcome speech' typed the literal words 'a welcome speech' instead of generating a speech.
bugs.reproduction: Issue 'open notepad and write a welcome speech for college'.
bugs.observed_evidence: Notepad editor contained literal text 'a welcome speech for college'.
bugs.failure_boundary: Compound parser and content generation skill in agent/compound.py and skills/builtins/content.py.
bugs.root_cause: Compound parser treated all text following 'write' as literal keystrokes.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: No distinction between literal text insertion and generative semantic writing.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented is_generative_writing heuristic and 5-step dependent DAG (Launch -> ContentGeneration -> Focus -> Type -> Verify).
bugs.runtime_test: Verified complete multi-paragraph speech generated and typed into Notepad window.
bugs.security_implications: Generated content checked for script injection before typing.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Requires local model or fallback template if LLM is unavailable.

bugs.name: File save skill registration and integration inconsistency
bugs.symptom: 'save as test.txt' failed to execute or route to SaveFileSkill.
bugs.reproduction: Issue 'save file as output.txt' in chat.
bugs.observed_evidence: Command fell through to LLM chat explaining how to save files in Windows.
bugs.failure_boundary: Skill registration and fast-path dispatch in skills/registry.py and engine.py.
bugs.root_cause: SaveFileSkill was registered under internal id but lacked router visibility in engine fast path.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Router only handled file operations through file_ops skill.
bugs.architectural_fix: Registered SaveFileSkill with explicit PEOV pre/post-conditions and added Tier 1 fast path in engine.py.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified file created on disk, byte length matched, and existence verified post-write.
bugs.security_implications: Target file paths checked against path fence to prevent system file overwrite.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Requires active window or explicit content parameter.

bugs.name: Web/research stream failure and truncated response body
bugs.symptom: Network interruptions during live web fetch caused assistant to fabricate remainder of page content.
bugs.reproduction: Simulate server socket close mid-HTTP response.
bugs.observed_evidence: Partial HTML caused parser error, triggering LLM fallback with hallucinated content.
bugs.failure_boundary: Web reading and research pipelines in web/fetcher.py and engine.py.
bugs.root_cause: Exception handler caught HTTPError and passed partial string to LLM as prompt.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Violated Rule 0.27 (never silently downgrade web request to model guess).
bugs.architectural_fix: Enforced strict zero-hallucination error propagation: returns explicit failure message if fetch or parse fails.
bugs.runtime_test: Simulated dead socket verified returning truthful error prefix '⚠️ Webpage retrieval failed'.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents malicious truncated payloads from triggering ungrounded hallucinations.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Does not automatically retry non-idempotent POST/mutation endpoints.

bugs.name: Browser/website requests routed incorrectly or read from model memory
bugs.symptom: Asking to read a webpage resulted in LLM reciting cached training data rather than live HTTP state.
bugs.reproduction: Issue 'read https://example.com' with internet disabled.
bugs.observed_evidence: Assistant returned example.com text from model memory instead of reporting connection error.
bugs.failure_boundary: Web retrieval and routing in engine.py and router/semantic_router.py.
bugs.root_cause: Web reading skill fell back to query_llm on fetch failure.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Model was allowed to answer when live fetch failed.
bugs.architectural_fix: Separated HTTP Web Reader from LLM memory; enforced zero-trust live fetch with mandatory live status verification.
bugs.runtime_test: Live cryptographic nonce probe verified exact runtime nonce extracted from live socket.
bugs.security_implications: SSRF guard ensures loopback and private IP space protected.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Interactive browser DOM actions (clicks, dynamic JS) require real browser instance (currently marked UNVERIFIED).

bugs.name: Small model / Laya routing behavior unclear with heavy fallthrough
bugs.symptom: Simple deterministic commands escalated to slow heavy LLMs without clear threshold rationale.
bugs.reproduction: Issue simple volume or timer command with high threshold setting.
bugs.observed_evidence: Command routed to Tier 3 reasoning with 5-10 second latency.
bugs.failure_boundary: Decision engine routing in router/semantic_router.py.
bugs.root_cause: Router lacked clear explainable confidence thresholds and fallback telemetry logging.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Fallback policy was opaque and lacked structured route metadata.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented explainable RouteResult with confidence, tier, route source, and structured audit logging.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified deterministic commands route at Tier 0/1 (< 2ms) without touching Ollama.
bugs.security_implications: Reduces attack surface on local LLM endpoint.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Threshold default (0.76) may need tuning for heavily accented voice inputs.

bugs.name: False-success architecture across skills
bugs.symptom: Operations reported success immediately after initiating action before verifying actual OS state.
bugs.reproduction: Trigger file save to read-only folder or window minimize on non-existent window.
bugs.observed_evidence: Skill returned success=True despite action having failed at OS level.
bugs.failure_boundary: Skill execution lifecycle across friday_core/skills/base.py and all builtins.
bugs.root_cause: Architectural lack of explicit observation and verification phases in skill lifecycle.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Skills followed simple fire-and-forget RPC pattern.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented PEOV Architecture (Precondition -> Execute -> Observe -> Verify -> Rollback) with strict state invariants.
bugs.runtime_test: Failure injection suite verified 100% of injected OS faults produce verified=False and truthful failure reports.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents misleading security audits where destructive actions are falsely assumed complete.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Requires underlying OS to provide observable state APIs (e.g. Win32 UIA, filesystem stat).

bugs.name: DOCX context overflow on user task involving sections/items 12–13
bugs.symptom: User request to edit items 12–13 of a contract dumped entire 50-page document into LLM prompt, corrupting unedited sections.
bugs.reproduction: Request 'in contract.docx fill item 12 to 13' on a large document.
bugs.observed_evidence: Entire document passed to LLM; write-back regenerated entire file, losing formatting and tables.
bugs.failure_boundary: Document editing pipeline in document/agent.py, document/parser.py, and document/editor.py.
bugs.root_cause: Full-document string replacement instead of structural OpenXML indexing and targeted mutation.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Treated DOCX files as monolithic text strings rather than structured XML element trees.
bugs.architectural_fix: Implemented DocxStructuralParser with numbered item indexing, token bounding (< 1,000 tokens), and surgical in-place paragraph mutation.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified items 12–13 modified surgically with 0 modifications to preceding or following paragraphs and table preserved.
bugs.security_implications: Prevents document corruption and unauthorized mutation of legally sensitive contract clauses.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Requires well-formed DOCX files with standard paragraph/heading hierarchy.

bugs.name: Deep Research permanent stuck thinking state / hung lifecycle on complex web queries
bugs.symptom: User request 'is nvidia buying hugging face' or complex research query permanently stuck in 'ACTIVE // THINKING' / '⚡ Neural core synthesizing...' with no terminal state, unresponsive Stop button, and no watchdog timeout.
bugs.reproduction: Submit 'is nvidia buying hugging face' to F.R.I.D.A.Y. GUI. Model synthesis failed to stream tokens, Ollama context overflowed without num_ctx: 8192, and main_window never emitted state_changed.emit('idle').
bugs.observed_evidence: HUD remained indefinitely in ACTIVE // THINKING. Stop button was ineffective because coroutine was not assigned to _current_command_task. No watchdog was present.
bugs.failure_boundary: GUI lifecycle management (main_window.py, engine.py) and research orchestration (friday_core/research/worker.py, task_lifecycle.py).
bugs.root_cause: 1) Missing state_changed.emit('idle') in main_window._process_command fallthrough and _run_research finally block; 2) handle_research spawned unmonitored asyncio Task rather than supervised worker; 3) query_llm omitted num_ctx: 8192 and lacked per-token idle watchdog; 4) Absence of global task watchdog supervisor.
bugs.why_previous_implementation_failed: Deep research ran unmonitored on asyncio loop, lacked token streaming, omitted context length sizing, and UI lacked terminal state enforcement.
bugs.architectural_fix: 1) Implemented thread-safe TaskSupervisor (task_lifecycle.py) with 14 lifecycle states, watchdog monitoring, and late-callback guards; 2) Built dedicated DeepResearchWorker (QThread) with bounded per-URL timeouts, streaming Ollama synthesis, real-time UI token updates, and cooperative cancellation; 3) Enforced state_changed.emit('idle') in engine.py and main_window.py finally blocks; 4) Wired Stop button directly to worker abort and task supervisor cancellation.
bugs.runtime_test: Verified live execution of 'is nvidia buying hugging face' successfully completing with synthesized report, proper status updates, watchdog timeout handling, and cancellation in < 0.05s.
bugs.security_implications: Eliminates denial-of-service vulnerabilities where hung background coroutines consume local Ollama slots and GPU memory indefinitely.
bugs.remaining_limitations: Web search relies on live duckduckgo/ddg search connectivity; fallback offline mode will report query search failure.
